description: Search 7,300+ ServiceNow system properties (sys_properties) by partial name or by topic. Works with name fragments like "glide.email", "saml2" or "sc.max" and with plain language topics like "attachment size limit", "session timeout", "SSO login", "password policy", "list performance" or "email notifications". Use this when the user asks which property controls a behavior, how to configure something in ServiceNow, or wants a list of related properties. Returns names, short summaries and sysproperties.do links; then call get_servicenow_property for full details. Include the relevant links in your answer.

max.description: Maximum number of properties to return. Max allowed is 50.

query.description: Property name fragment or topic, e.g. "glide.ui" or "attachment size limit". If omitted, returns a general list.

name: search_servicenow_properties
title: Search ServiceNow system properties
